value.text: Read-only profiles of the live machine daemon pid 95125 (R1): `sample` 5 s and 10 s, `vmmap --summary`, `ps -M`, `lsof -iTCP:7461`, read-only sqlite, `just spawn-rate --seconds 20`. 2.0 cores busy: D1 /v1/events subscribe full-spine decode 1.09 cores (55%), D3 sidecar bg open() 0.37, D4 tap open() 0.24. 2,978,027 spine rows, 2,416,965 of them bg.lost at 10/s since 2026-10-26 02:24Z (D2). Tap dir 3.1 GB, 3.19 GB of it orphans (D5). A cliff, not a merge from 2026-10-29. Sent to the prime before fixing; accepted with notes. assets/evidence/diagnosis.md.

Recorded-workload replay crates/daemon/tests/spine_attach_cost.rs (release, /usr/bin/time -l), main d459dda: one cursor attach on 561,000 rows 0.85-0.93 s, 0.99 GB peak; on 2,978,027 rows 6.3-7.2 s, 5.1 GB peak. Branch: 0.4-1.2 ms (one 357 ms outlier), 14 MB peak. assets/evidence/attach-before.txt, attach-after.txt.

F1 (D1): required Spine::newest (SELECT MAX(seq)), EventBus::subscribe uses it. RED with main's subscribe restored: `a_cursor_attach_never_reads_the_spine_before_its_cursor` left: [Seq(0), Seq(48)] right: [Seq(48)]; GREEN on the branch. spine_contract asserts newest on fake and SQLite. assets/evidence/f1-red.txt.

F2 (D2): completion published once (latest_matching_message guard); tombstoned owner -> one bg.final-turn-dropped with reason, mark_notified; RepeatedFailureLog in the background loop. RED main-equivalent (both hunks reverted): a_retried_completion left 2 right 1, a_tombstoned_owners_source FAILED; each hunk alone killed by its own test; every_new_job_still_publishes_its_own_completion green throughout (prime note). assets/evidence/f2-red-mutants.txt.

F3 (D3): sidecar BgWorker ScanIndex: dir mtime gate (settled >= 2 s) plus terminal-id index. RED on main source: `bg_worker_never_reopens_a_terminal_record_and_still_reads_new_ones` panicked 'could not read record ... done-a.json: Permission denied'; GREEN on the branch. assets/evidence/f3-red-main.txt.

F4/F5: drain_pane_tap stats first; TAP_TRIM_BYTES 1 MiB trim; per-server tap ledger, default-server one-time legacy claim (prime ruling), orphan sweep once per boot. Real private -L tmux tests. First trim design (trim right after a read) lost ~1-2 KB in 2 of 35 runs under a 4 MB/s burst: moved trimming to the first quiet drain; 30/30 green after. Sweep tests: -L never claims; live-pane legacy sink survives; <5 min sink survives; other server's ledgered sink never claimed.

D6 found by the private replay: RSS flat 4.6 GB from +15 s on the F1-F5 build; boot sample: 1,549/3,025 busy samples in GovernanceService::reconcile_deliveries -> tail(None, Seq(0)). F6 pages recipients' delivery.outcome/dispatch rows via matching_since. `reconciliation_projects_deliveries_without_reading_whole_histories` killed by both whole-history mutants (M16, M17).

Private daemon (temp HOME/state dir, private -L tmux, R2), recorded workload: 2,978,027 spine rows, one stranded events source with a tombstoned owner, a chainglass-like attach every 3.7 s. main d459dda: CPU 37.2 s/60 s (62%), RSS 4.74/5.26/5.63 GB at +15/+60/+120 s, spine +1,199 bg.lost in 120 s, 1,205 repeated log lines. Branch: CPU 0.82 s/60 s (1.4%), RSS 17/15/15 MB, spine +0 (one bg.final-turn-dropped), 0 repeated lines, spawns 2 both. Live before (pid 95125): 197-208% CPU, 8.4-9.1 GB, 0.9 launches/s, du 3.1 GB. The prime takes the deployed after-reading. assets/evidence/private-main.txt, private-branch2.txt.

Mutants (assets/evidence/mutants.py): 15/15 killed, each by its intended test (M1, M2, M5-M17), plus M3/M4 in lg-0004; unmutated baseline green. Trap found: restoring a file from a backup older than the mutant build leaves the MUTANT compiled (cargo sees no newer source); the first full run was invalid for that reason and was re-run after bumping mtimes. assets/evidence/mutants.txt.
Docs: docs/how/daemon-cost.md (steady-state cost per loop and per seat, measuring recipes, tap bound, sweep policy vs brake, ledger), macos-defender.md (open() cost), pij-pane-signals.md (tap bound).

`just rust-check` (cargo metadata --locked, fmt --check, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test --locked --workspace) on the head rebased onto main 8687560 (a7c8da3): exit 0, 1,749 passed, 0 failed, 9 ignored.
